name: polycystin 2, transient receptor potential cation channel
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PKD2 encodes polycystin-2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription regulator inhibitor activity and potassium channel activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and aorta development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (autosomal dominant); polycystic kidney disease 2 (autosomal dominant).
